name: smartypants
description: Keeps a Mermaid-style system diagram and a compact memory of your architectural intent while an agent codes, goes deeper on any part on request, and flags where the code drifts from the intent.

meta_api_key.title: Meta Model API key
meta_api_key.description: Used by the default builder (Muse Spark on api.meta.ai). Leave empty if META_API_KEY is already in your environment or you use another builder flavor.

typesafe_api_key.title: Typesafe (Jev) API key (optional)
typesafe_api_key.description: Optional: Jev answers the per-turn triage questions. Without it, Muse Spark or local rules do.
